title: A batch of audit events (POST /v1/events)
description: Ids only, never names or e-mails: an e-mail address anywhere refuses the event. Each event is checked on its own; a refused one is named with its reason, the others are kept, in the batch's order.

event_id.description: The host's id for the event (its outbox makes one, a UUID v7): sent twice, it is kept once.

occurred_at.description: When it happened, by the host's clock: RFC 3339 with its offset, kept to the millisecond in UTC. At most 5 minutes ahead of the service's clock.

action.description: What happened, as the host names it: customer.viewed, key.revealed, lease.exported.

actor.description: Who did it: one of the host's people, one of its operators, or the system (a job, a command).

subject.description: The person the data is about: their access report lists every event naming them here (or as a target of type person).

account.description: The account (a workspace, an organisation) it happened in.

reason.description: The operator's reason, when the host asked for one.

context.description: Anything else, as an object: at most 4 levels deep and 8 KB as JSON.
